classification.difficultyReason: Constructs three graphs on common axes and uses their intersections to interpret a double inequality with inclusive endpoints.

answer.worked:
The line $y=2x-5$ has intercepts $(0,-5)$ and $\left(\frac{5}{2},0\right)$. Sketch it together with the two horizontal lines.

At $y=-1$:
$$\begin{align*}2x-5&=-1\\2x&=4\\x&=2\end{align*}$$
At $y=5$:
$$\begin{align*}2x-5&=5\\2x&=10\\x&=5\end{align*}$$
Mark the intersections $(2,-1)$ and $(5,5)$.
